proposals.title: Airframe micro-scratch normal breakup
proposals.change: Add a restrained fine-scratch normal layer to exposed Yak airframe metal.
proposals.implementation_notes: Blend an existing imported scratch normal at low strength over the HF metal response; keep base color and roughness unchanged and mask to broad exposed panels.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Unlit HF-only treatment preserves the Loop52 bright material baseline and adds no hero geometry or dark FOV regions.
proposals.acceptance_test: Loop52 capture remains 11/11 usable; YakBeauty shows fine edge breakup without a new black patch.

proposals.title: Airframe panel roughness variance
proposals.change: Introduce subtle roughness variation between adjacent airframe panels.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use an existing panel mask or imported roughness tile with narrow contrast; bias toward satin-versus-matte separation without darkening albedo.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only roughness is varied, retaining current luminance and avoiding dark-metal sole-FOV behavior.
proposals.acceptance_test: YakBeauty and Cockpit retain usable framing and show readable panel breaks without washout.

proposals.title: Airframe seam AO restraint
proposals.change: Add a thin ambient-occlusion accent to selected airframe panel seams.
proposals.implementation_notes: Multiply a low-opacity seam AO mask into existing shading and clamp the minimum value so seams cannot become black bars.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is narrow, local, and luminance-clamped, with no effect on distant views.
proposals.acceptance_test: YakBeauty gains seam definition while black-pixel coverage stays flat or improves.

proposals.title: Airframe lower-surface dust gradient
proposals.change: Add a soft, low-contrast dust accumulation gradient to lower airframe surfaces.
proposals.implementation_notes: Project a warm-gray dirt response through a height-biased mask; exclude canopy, nose highlight, and cockpit instrument FOV.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The dust is a subtle material layer on existing surfaces and remains away from horizon and ocean pixels.
proposals.acceptance_test: The lower Yak reads lightly field-used while Cockpit readability and 11/11 usability remain unchanged.

proposals.title: Airframe edge polish strip
proposals.change: Add a narrow brighter response along selected airframe panel lips.
proposals.implementation_notes: Drive a very low-intensity neutral-warm additive highlight from an existing edge mask; limit it to thin strips.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: This is a small emissive proxy over existing panel edges with negligible influence outside the Yak close view.
proposals.acceptance_test: Panel lips gain one readable highlight pass without clipping sky or increasing black coverage.

proposals.title: Prop disc translucent value band
proposals.change: Add one restrained brightness band to the spinning propeller disc material.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place a narrow low-opacity band in the existing disc UVs and keep emission dim enough to preserve hub contrast.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is additive, tiny, and isolated to the prop disc.
proposals.acceptance_test: Prop and PropHub show a stable readable disc ring without obscuring the hub.

proposals.title: Prop disc radial breakup
proposals.change: Introduce subtle radial breakup so the prop disc reads as a rotating surface rather than a flat blur.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a low-contrast radial mask to modulate the existing disc response; keep the center clear and change no blade geometry.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: It affects only the existing rotating disc material with a restrained additive signal.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropNose retains nose-edge readability and Prop gains radial motion structure without overexposure.

proposals.title: Prop hub brushed-metal grain
proposals.change: Add a fine brushed-metal normal and roughness cue to the prop hub.
proposals.implementation_notes: Apply grain only inside the existing hub mask; use a neutral mid-value base and preserve the current bright rim.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The detail is confined to the existing hub material and maintains a non-dark base value.
proposals.acceptance_test: PropHub gains visible concentric brushing without blackening the hub or reducing disc separation.

proposals.title: Prop blade leading-edge wear
proposals.change: Add a thin warm-gray wear response to propeller blade leading edges.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use an existing blade-edge mask with a low-contrast albedo/roughness blend; keep wear discontinuous and narrower than the blade width.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: This is a local material-only edge cue with no aircraft silhouette change.
proposals.acceptance_test: Leading edges read lightly worn in Prop while PropNose remains clear and no dark stripe appears.

proposals.title: Prop disc center-to-rim fade
proposals.change: Refine the disc material with a gentle center-to-rim value fade.
proposals.implementation_notes: Add very low-strength radial emission that rises toward the outer disc and falls to zero at the hub boundary.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The effect is additive, localized, and kept below highlight clipping.
proposals.acceptance_test: The prop disc separates cleanly from the hub and nose at Loop52 exposure.

proposals.title: Rifle tan woven grain
proposals.change: Add subtle woven grain to the rifle tan stock material.
proposals.implementation_notes: Blend fine grain only into the tan stock and strap mask; preserve the tan albedo family and broad silhouette.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The existing tan value remains intact and detail is confined to the rifle asset.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS shows tactile stock grain without adding noise to the cockpit background.

proposals.title: Rifle tan corner abrasion
proposals.change: Add a small lighter abrasion mask to rifle tan corners and handling zones.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use stock curvature or an existing UV edge mask for a few low-opacity warm-gray marks; do not darken the base tan.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The marks are small, bright-biased, and limited to the ADS rifle material.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS reads as handled and worn while the rifle remains clearly tan.

proposals.title: Rifle worn-metal roughness pass
proposals.change: Add restrained roughness variation to exposed rifle metal parts.
proposals.implementation_notes: Apply an existing roughness tile through the metal-part mask, keeping metal base color mid-value and avoiding a blackened receiver or sight.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only micro-roughness changes on existing rifle metal; no dark PBR-only FOV material is introduced.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS gains receiver and sight material separation while Cockpit retains usable instrument contrast.

proposals.title: Rifle metal-to-tan contact AO
proposals.change: Add tiny contact AO accents where rifle metal meets the tan stock.
proposals.implementation_notes: Multiply a narrow, clamped AO mask into existing rifle shading at the receiver/stock junction and sight mounts.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The AO is local and clamped, with no geometry or global lighting change.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS shows clearer component contact without a heavy dark stripe.

proposals.title: Rifle metal wear flecks
proposals.change: Add a few restrained highlight flecks to worn rifle metal.
proposals.implementation_notes: Drive low-intensity neutral emission through a sparse fleck mask on receiver and sight edges; clamp contribution below highlight clipping.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse additive pixels provide local readability and cannot form a broad dark or washed-out region.
proposals.acceptance_test: ADS gains small metal wear cues with no exposure shift or loss of tan separation.

proposals.title: Behind-wall vertical oxidation variation
proposals.change: Add localized reddish oxidation variation to one structural surface behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the surface at x>=bx+3 and use a low-frequency oxidation mask with a lifted value range; avoid a tiled rectangular decal or foreground-wall overlap.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The authored weathering is fully occluded in active FOV and does not create a new hero stack.
proposals.acceptance_test: Behind-wall inspection confirms localized oxidation variation; Loop52 remains 11/11 usable.

proposals.title: Behind-wall mineral dirt deposit
proposals.change: Add a compact pale mineral-dirt deposit to one pipe recess behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the affected recess at x>=bx+3; use a narrow lower-edge mask with pale gray-beige dirt and no repeated brick or plaster pattern.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Behind-wall placement removes the accent from all active camera compositions.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor remains fully usable and behind-wall inspection shows one localized mineral deposit.

proposals.title: Behind-wall moisture roughness patch
proposals.change: Add a small moisture-driven roughness patch to a utility hatch behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use roughness and AO modulation only on one hatch at x>=bx+3; preserve its mid-value base color and avoid a black wet decal.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The treatment is hidden behind the wall and does not alter any aircraft or horizon material.
proposals.acceptance_test: Behind-wall inspection shows a readable damp-versus-dry break without blackening; Combat remains usable.

proposals.title: Behind-wall drainage grime accumulation
proposals.change: Add a narrow grime accumulation response inside one drainage recess behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Mask only the recess interior at x>=bx+3, using a soft dirt gradient and lifted minimum output; do not place it on the foreground deck seam.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accent is occluded, narrow, and isolated from Ocean and Wide compositions.
proposals.acceptance_test: Material inspection confirms grime confined to the drainage recess; Harbor remains 11/11-safe.

proposals.title: Behind-wall salt-streak roughness
proposals.change: Add two short salt-streak roughness marks to a weathered support behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the support at x>=bx+3 and use thin, broken roughness streaks with restrained value contrast; avoid a full-surface rust tile treatment.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The weathering remains fully behind the wall and cannot affect protected FOV materials.
proposals.acceptance_test: Behind-wall review shows two readable salt streaks with no foreground spill; Combat and Harbor remain usable.
